information: Saturday's events: 3x3x3 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx, Skewb. Sunday's events: 6x6x6 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Square-1, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. #### All competitors under the age of 18 must bring a signed waiver, available soon. Hosted by Reno Rubik's Cube Club at the University of Nevada, Reno. 3x3x3 Multi-Blind competitors must not compete in the following events: 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded. **The registration cost is different than previous competitions.** Please consult the 'Register' tab for more information.
